deepdive.sec: Engineering R&D Services & Industrial AI Transition

bull_bear.body: Net cash Rs 3,394 cr; strong FCF (Rs 540 cr, 153% of NI this quarter; 90-95% guided for year). Continued investment in EI and the Six Technology Bets. Portfolio pruning ongoing (SWC divestment concluding Q2). EPS +~15% YoY on continuing operations reflects mix + prudent capital allocation. No buyback/dividend change flagged on call.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation

bull_bear.body:
- Europe Auto/Tier-1 weakness (China demand evaporating, model-year pushouts) — recovery is "to be played out."
- Large-deal timing slippage (a few Q1 wins moved to Q2); Telecom deal must close/ramp as promised.
- Tech segment must actually inflect to growth from Q2.
- AI cannibalization debate: LTTS argues AI expands (not replaces) engineering work, but must keep passing some productivity to clients to win — margin/volume balance to monitor.
- Forex/hedge-loss drag on other income for next few quarters.
- Middle East geopolitics (small direct exposure; some Q1 execution delay).
bull_bear.title: Risks & watch-items

bull_bear.body: Confident, candid, detail-rich; deliberately gives a 5-year outlook + quarterly growth commitment but declines annual guidance (by investor feedback). Amit Chadha personally did 48 client meetings in Apr-May. Transparent on deal slippage and the SWC exit. "Paranoid" framing on staying ahead of AI disruption. Reconfirms prior commitments rather than resetting them — credibility-positive.
bull_bear.title: Management quality / tone

bull_bear.body:
- The lower dollar revenue base vs a year ago is engineered (SWC exit + "empty calories" pruning), so headline dollar growth understates the healthier, higher-margin underlying book.
- Management's counter to "AI kills IT/ER&D": the two large model providers and a hyperscaler have each set up their own services companies — if services were dying, they wouldn't.
- "Owner's engineer" repositioning (via Claude + tools) is a scope/pricing upgrade, not just a productivity story — LTTS increasingly owns the client's process/IP, not just staffing it.
- Sustainability could have grown more but for talent constraints — a hiring bottleneck, not a demand one.
- Company now commits to sequential margin AND revenue growth every quarter — an unusually specific bar to be held to.
bull_bear.title: Non-obvious takeaways

bull_bear.body:
- Q1FY27 free cash flow (continuing operations) was INR 5,396 million, representing 153% of net income, with capex of INR 351 million.
- Aspiration to achieve 13â15% CAGR over next five years while maintaining EBIT margins of 16â17% under Lakshya 31 plan.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)

business.body:
- **Mobility:** +2.3% QoQ, broad-based (Aero & Rail + T&OH led; US Auto recovered — "worst from US auto behind us"). Margin 15.6% (slight dip on onsite ramp of new programs). Europe OEM/Tier-1 still weak (China exposure vanishing, model-year pushouts) but LTTS positioned to win vendor consolidation from a lower cost base. No sub-split disclosed anymore.
- **Sustainability:** +4.3% QoQ, +11.3% YoY; margin 29.1% (+40 bps), most profitable. Plant Engineering strong across Upstream O&G/LNG/Chemicals; Industrial Products strong across Data Centers, Electrical Equipment, Motion & Robotics, Automation. Ainfonix platform gaining adoption. Could have grown more with more talent (hiring).
- **Tech:** soft quarter, margin 11.5%; now 30.6% of revenue (was 34.4% a yr ago) — reflects SWC exit + Sustainability outgrowth. MedTech program concluded + next delayed; a medical deal and Telecom deal in pipeline. Returns to growth from Q2; not expected back to ~34% mix.
business.title: Segment / subsidiary detail

business.body:
- **Time-to-market lead:** management asserts LTTS is "6 to 9 months ahead of competition" in EI — a differentiation window, not a permanent moat, requiring continuous reinvestment.
- **Pricing power / non-commodity positioning:** "Nobody has ever come back and say reduce your rates… we are not a commodity player" — differentiated higher-end engineering supports margin expansion even as some AI productivity is passed on to win deals.
- **Diversification as defense:** three Mobility sectors × three geographies (US/Europe/ROW) cushioned the Europe-auto downturn — evidenced by US Auto + T&OH/Aero offsetting Europe this quarter.

latest_quarter.body: EBIT 15.7% (+50 bps QoQ, +200 bps YoY). Three margin levers reiterated: (1) mix shift to higher-margin Sustainability/Mobility + improving Tech, (2) EI-led delivery productivity, (3) operational excellence + disciplined SG&A. Rupee depreciation (Rs 94.86/$, -1.5% QoQ) a tailwind but partly offset by hedge losses in other income. Offshore mix 53.9% (room to improve); T&M mix down to 64.9% as fixed-price/outcome deals rise. Headcount steady 23,845; attrition 14.7%.
latest_quarter.title: Margins & cost dynamics

latest_quarter.body:
- **Q1 FY27 (this):** Rev $309.9 mn (+1.5% QoQ CC, +1.9% YoY CC) / Rs 2,940 cr (+11.5% YoY); EBIT 15.7% (+50 bps QoQ, +200 bps YoY); NI Rs 352 cr (+17.4% YoY); FCF 153% of NI; cash Rs 3,394 cr. Sustainability +4.3% QoQ (29.1% margin), Mobility +2.3% QoQ (15.6%), Tech soft (11.5%, 30.6% mix). ~$100 mn TCV (a few deals slipped to Q2). Anthropic/Claude + Databricks partnerships; Munich EI Center; 100 forward-deployment engineers. Guidance reconfirmed: 13-15% 5-yr CAGR, 16-17% margin, mid-16% by/before Q4FY27, sequential rev+margin growth every quarter, Sustainability double-digit FY27, Tech growth from Q2.
- _Q2 FY27 → check: slipped Q1 large deals + Telecom deal actually closing/ramping; Tech returning to growth; SWC divestment concluded; mid-16% margin trajectory; FCF normalizing to 90-95%; Mobility Auto (Europe) recovery; Sustainability double-digit held._

outlook.body:
- **Revenue growth:** 13-15% CAGR over the next 5 years (Lakshya 31); **sequential revenue growth every quarter** reconfirmed; growth committed for Q2 (no annual outlook given by policy).
- **Margin:** 16-17% EBIT band (5-yr aspiration); **mid-16% EBIT on or before Q4 FY27**; sequential margin expansion each quarter of FY27.
- **Segment:** Sustainability double-digit YoY growth for FY27 (reconfirmed); Tech to return to growth from Q2; Mobility gradual improvement through the year.
- **Cash / tax / WC:** FCF ~90-95% of net income for FY27 (Q1 was 153%, a working-capital outperformance); ETR 26.2-26.7%; combined DSO 80-85 days.
- **Corporate action:** SWC (Smart World) divestment to conclude in Q2 FY27.
outlook.title: Guidance (CRITICAL — verify next quarter)

outlook.body: Large-deal TCV ~$100 mn in Q1, with a few large wins pushed to early Q2 (not broad-based; partly Europe summer + client-specific timing). Pipeline described as strengthened vs last quarter/year. Named wins/expansions: Emerson (global System Integrator & tech-development partner), a leading Aerospace connectivity platform, an EV manufacturer expansion (exterior/lighting), an Ophthalmology/microsurgery offshore engineering center, and a leading global energy company (ramping). A "significant" Telecom deal expected to close early Q2 with immediate ramp; more medical-domain deals in negotiation. Flexible ramp-up model lets execution start on deal close.
outlook.title: Order book & pipeline

outlook.body:
- **Engineering Intelligence (EI):** the core thesis — "6-layer AI cake" (energy, chips, infra, data engineering, AI models, applications) mapped to the Six Technology Bets. Toolkit: PlxAI, AiNexus, AiTest, Ainfonix (aid), AgenticIQ (autonomy/agents), Track AI / Physical AI (embedded). Consulting entry via MIT Media Labs AI Readiness Index → paid AI-maturity assessments → rollout.
- **Anthropic/Claude partnership:** integrating Claude models across engineering processes and LTTS platforms (AgenticIQ, PlxAI); plus Databricks tie-up. Positions LTTS as "owner's engineer" (e.g., compressing a client's 36-40-month design cycle to 15-18 months).
- **New capabilities:** Munich EI Center (Europe's first), 244 AI patents (1,757 total), 100 forward-deployment engineers, FinTech first Private-Equity client, PharmaWiseAI for life-sciences R&D.
outlook.title: Growth verticals / optionality

deepdive.thesis: A clean "steady execution" start to FY27 on a rebased portfolio: constant-currency revenue +1.5% QoQ / +1.9% YoY with EBIT margin up to 15.7% (+50 bps QoQ, +200 bps YoY) and net income +17.4% YoY, as Sustainability (+4.3% QoQ, ~29% margin) and a recovering Mobility (+2.3% QoQ) offset a soft, SWC-exited Tech (11.5% margin). The narrative is fully pivoted to "Engineering Intelligence" — an Anthropic/Claude tie-up, a Munich EI center, and 100 forward-deployment engineers — and management explicitly reconfirmed sequential revenue AND margin growth every quarter, mid-16% EBIT by/before Q4FY27, and the Lakshya-31 13-15% 5-year revenue CAGR at 16-17% margins.
